minor.issue: Situational Business Challenge returns registration_open=null (field not backfilled in DB). Pydantic default isn't re-applied on read because legacy docs predate the field. Frontend currently treats null as 'not strictly false' so the form still renders, but it's inconsistent. Recommend a one-time migration to set registration_open=true on all legacy event docs, or coerce in the list/detail serializer.
